reviews.t: I recommend getting your transmission fixed somewhere else. I should’ve followed my gut when I hired this guy. At first it seemed like he knew what he was talking about but just didn’t have a ton of experience with my particular transmission. Overall just seems like he doesn’t know what he doesn’t know and won’t admit when he doesn’t know something. Technicians need to be able to know when to turn down jobs they aren’t qualified for. I’ve been dealing with trying to figure out what’s wrong and him not admitting fault since February. Dropped the trans off in November and wasted my time in January putting in the one he “rebuilt”. He blamed the hard shifts on not being programmed and then when he programmed it he blamed the electrical system. He couldn’t articulate what was wrong other than “it would take some time to figure it out” meanwhile cars just kept being pushed ahead of me while my business truck kept burning months of being insured and not making money. Finally got fed up and took it to another shop who said it was a mechanical failure and shifty was sure that was not the case. After another month of no progress I took it to a real transmission shop and they had it fixed with a brand new transmission in less than a week. Paid shifty almost $5000 that he won’t refund and had to pay $7500 for a completely new unit. So please don’t learn your lesson the hard way. This guy will waste your time and won’t take responsibility even when he doesn’t know how to remedy the problem. What good is a “guarantee” when he won’t remedy the problem. It also took him a month to rebuild the transmission when it was supposed to take 4 days per his estimate.

Shifty recently rebuilt my transmission, replaced my rear main seal and a slew of other things my truck desperately needed. He finished all the work in less than a week! Communication was great, pricing was great. He is a true professional. My 2005 sierra Denali is running and driving better than it ever has! I will be using him in the future!

Shiftys was awesome , he rebuilt my truck transmission, got my 4x4 working, also fixed my air ride suspension. I would, and do, recommend him to everyone. It was nice dealing with Jeff directly as he kept me informed the entire time . Thanks Shiftys!

Shift's low overhead enables him to deliver a quality repair at a reasonable price for a working man like me. My work truck was completed quickly so I did not fall behind my commitments. I recommend Shifty's.

Brought a Nissan RS5R30A. Parts came with the unit. New synchros and bearings. Took weeks to get to, tried to charge $900. Put it in the vehicle only to find I don't have second gear and first and reverse are noisy. Now we have to pull the box and get it rebuilt by a professional.
Jeff was able to work us in, 2005 Dodge Caravan, rebuilt transmission. Good person to work with.
